title: Preserve cents when splitting a total
prompt: Fix `app/money.py` so `split_evenly(total_cents, people)` returns exactly `people` non-negative integer shares summing to `total_cents`. Distribute remainder cents from the first recipient onward. Reject `people <= 0` and negative totals with `ValueError`. Edit production code only; do not modify tests. Run `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v`.
